summary: Windows Autopilot OOBE stalls during BitLocker pre-provisioning for new hire laptop
description:
Issue summary: New-hire Dell XPS 15 (company asset tag 4728) failed automated provisioning via Windows Autopilot. Device stalls during OOBE at 'Preparing your device' with no progress for >20 minutes. BitLocker pre-provisioning step appears to hang (disk encryption not completed).

Impact: New hire (Jane Doe) cannot complete first-day setup. Device appears responsive but stuck in OOBE without reaching username/password/SSO stage. This blocks calendar and onboarding tasks.

Environment: Corporate network (corp-net, us-west office), Autopilot profile v3, Intune tenant: redwood-prod, provisioning agent 2025.11.2.

Steps to reproduce: 1) Boot device from factory image. 2) Device enters Windows OOBE and connects to office Wi-Fi. 3) Autopilot provisioning is launched. 4) OOBE shows 'Preparing your device' then moves to 'Encrypting disk' but progress stuck at 0% for >20m. 5) No Intune device record created in portal (device not visible under Devices > Windows > Autopilot).

Observed behavior: OOBE hangs during BitLocker pre-provisioning. Local event viewer entry not available due to OOBE context; provisioning logs indicate TPM provisioning step times out.

Expected behavior: Autopilot completes OOBE, device appears in Intune, BitLocker pre-provisioned and user can sign in with SSO.

Attachments: - Serial/asset: 4728, BIOS 1.7.3 - Provisioning log pulled from provisioning service: attached as provisioning-log-INT-5589.txt (see ticket attachments) - Slack thread: #it-onboarding (link below)
investigation:
Initial triage (Alex): confirmed device has network connectivity; attempted to re-image twice with same result. Verified DHCP and PXE (not used; using Autopilot over Wi-Fi). Observed provisioning service timing out on 'tpm:configure' stage.

Hypotheses checked: - TPM firmware bug: checked Dell BIOS v1.7.3 release notes; no known issue but TPM reported as 2.0 and healthy in BIOS. - BitLocker policy conflict: reviewed Intune Device Configuration profile 'BitLocker-Preprov' (last modified 2026-02-12) — policy looks correct. - Autopilot token/registration: device advertising in autopilot CS not present -> suggests provisioning did not reach registration step.

Actions taken: - Collected provisioning logs from device using USB WinPE (saved as provisioning-log-INT-5589.txt). - Manually cleared TPM via BIOS, re-ran Autopilot: OOBE advanced past BitLocker stage but then failed later during 'Apply device policies' with MDM enrollment error 80180026. - Created temporary Intune device record by uploading hardware hash (workaround) and assigned autopilot profile; re-run resulted in successful provisioning and user able to sign in.

Findings: Clearing TPM allowed BitLocker pre-provision to progress; however device still failed to auto-enroll into Intune when Autopilot was triggered from factory image. Manual hardware hash upload allowed an end-to-end successful flow.

Telemetry/links: - Provisioning logs (attached) - Intune device upload work noted in Slack #it-onboarding thread ts:2026-03-10T14:12Z - Related runbook: https://confluence.redwood.io/display/IT/Autopilot+Provisioning+Runbook
comments: 2026-03-10 10:42 - Alex Chen: Ticket created after first attempt by desk-side admin. Assigned to IT imaging queue. Noted asset and initial logs attached.
2026-03-10 11:05 - Priya Kapoor: Re-imaged device and reproduced hang. Suspect TPM state inconsistent on out-of-box devices from this vendor batch. Raising with vendor if we confirm multiple devices.

2026-03-10 11:38 - Michael Rivera (SRE): Can you paste the provisioning service correlation id from the log? We want to see if our Autopilot webhook retried or returned an error 500. Also check if network egress to login.windows.net was blocked during the timeframe.

2026-03-10 12:10 - Alex Chen: Added provisioning correlation id: 3a7f2b9c-0d4f-4e12-bc3a-7f9e6b1a2b8c. Verified corp egress allowed; no firewall drops in NOC logs for that time window.

Also: cleared TPM and retried (see investigation). Manual hardware hash upload allowed provisioning to succeed.
2026-03-11 09:22 - Priya Kapoor: Escalated to Vendor Support (Dell) with hardware serial; vendor asked for TPM event logs and BIOS dump. Ticket with vendor: DELL-98721. Pending vendor response.

2026-03-12 15:40 - IT Ops Manager, Jordan Blake: Temporary workaround documented in Autopilot runbook: if Autopilot stalls at BitLocker, clear TPM in BIOS and upload hardware hash to Intune to complete enrollment. We should avoid this for scale. Created follow-up task to update provisioning agent and add telemetry to detect 'tpm:configure' timeouts. See linked action INT-5591.
resolution: Workaround in place: desk-side admin cleared TPM, uploaded hardware hash to Intune, and completed provisioning manually for the affected asset. Longer-term: investigate provisioning agent retry logic and add telemetry/alert for tpm configuration timeouts. Vendor (Dell) engaged (DELL-98721). Follow-up engineering task INT-5591 created to implement agent fix and runbook update.
